title_as_printed: Notice of the Caribs in Central America. Communicated by Colonel Don Juan Galindo, F.R.G.S. Dated Government House, Trugillo, 1833.
author: Juan Galindo
journal: Journal of the Royal Geographical Society of London
heading_as_printed: I subjoin a short vocabulary of the Carib tongue, which it must be supposed has affinity with some of the languages of Western Africa, from the evident similarity of the Caribs to the negroes of that continent; ... CARIB VOCABULARY.
about: Words of the Caribs of Trugillo, whose people had been moved from St. Vincent to Roatan by the British in 1796 and then to Trugillo by the Spaniards, sent by Galindo from Government House, Trugillo, in 1833.
